title: Keto Garlic White Asparagus Salad
description: A light and cozy Norwegian dish featuring crisp white asparagus spears lightly fried with a generous amount of garlic for a garlicky kick.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Lightly spray the olive oil in the pan to prevent sticking.
Add minced garlic and sauté until fragrant, about 1 minute. Be cautious not to burn it.
Carefully add asparagus spears, ensuring they don't touch, and cook for another 3-5 minutes or until slightly tender but still crisp.
Remove from heat and stir in balsamic vinegar, salt, and pepper. Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary.
Let the salad cool before serving.
